# Alexandros Shomper — alexandrosshomper.de

> Product Lead and Designer with 15+ years of experience in B2B and B2C.
> Specialising in product-led growth, user onboarding, activation, and design systems.

## About
Alexandros Shomper is a remote-first, outcome-oriented product lead with experience
ranging from early-stage startups to corporate environments. Background in advertising,
marketing, and self-taught development.
